author: Guerrilla Miniature Games
description:
We're back with The Indie Hour Episode Eighty! This series focuses on games you may have never even heard of and gives us an inside look at the wider world of independently published Tabletop Wargames of all genres.

I LOVE a good re-skin and Matt Burns is back with a Colonial Horror era version of Don't Look Back in 1698. Beset by supernaturally killers, can the locals hold out the terror that has always lived in the Northwoods? Let's check it out!

Check out the physical and digital rulebook HERE https://blacksitestudio.com/en-ca/products/1698-expansion-book
title: The GMG Indie Hour Ep 082 - 1698 by Matt Burns & Black Site Studio
